Daughters of the sea, their spirits and flesh corroded by the sins of Destruction, leaving only empty, distorted shells... In this life, they follow the Ocean's honed blade, not to be obliterated into nihility, but to become the tidal waves crashing against the Dark Sun.

The pinnacle of logic and composure... or is he? He maintains a constant air of unshakeable calm, as if he's a walking encyclopedia of wisdom and lore, but at his core, he's just a sardonic loser with a talent for snark.
"My job is simply to decide what to do. As for whether it's actually possible... well, that's for you all to worry about... Holy Aha, you guys are actually doing it!?"

enemies.name: Vessel of the Destruction, Khaslana
enemies.lore: Phainon, NeiKos496, Deliverer, Khaslana, The Nameless Hero. Through times longer than chronicles could tell, he fought against the hatred and rage in his heart, until his body withered away. All to await this destined moment, when another Deliverer would extinguish the night's fire and bring forth a new dawn.

skills.name: Destined Casket
skills.desc: Khaslana will not strike at heroes who are unwavering in their resolve. He has wrestled with destiny for eons, burned away his very being, and now stands empty, save for the hope he entrusts to you.

enemies.image: Enemy Vessel of the Destruction, Khaslana.png

enemies.name: Voidranger: Distorter
enemies.lore:
A Voidranger that has successfully survived particle annihilation, the positive and negative particles in its body have temporarily achieved a strange balance, granting them more power than ordinary reavers.
Basic combat units of the Antimatter Legion. They possess some intelligence and are able to control reavers within a small surrounding area.

skills.name: Nihility's Command
skills.desc: Locks Onto (Vulnerability +10%) a random unit on your team, making them the target for incoming attacks from all of their enemies.

skills.name: Shadowless Void Strike
skills.desc: Deals Quantum DMG (500% ATK) to a single target.

enemies.name: Voidranger: Eliminator
enemies.lore:
Bodies that continued to be corroded by the Fragmentum after death. While their vital signs have changed, they continue to carry out their orders to eliminate.
Voidranger: Eliminators will mark enemies they hit, causing them to take extra damage when attacked.

skills.name: Void Cannon
skills.desc: Deals Imaginary DMG (400% ATK) to a single target, with a chance (75% Base Chance) to afflict Detonated (3 uses). This unit becomes Overloaded.

skills.name: Thermal Barrier
skills.desc: Dispels this unit's Overloaded state.

enemies.name: Voidranger: Reaver
enemies.lore:
Warriors yet to perish were recast in the Warforge and gained the Destruction's power. Antimatter completes their bodies and negative particles reverberate throughout their forms.
Violently aggressive, they embody the will of the Destruction and are basic combat units of the Antimatter Legion, acting only according to their destructive instincts.

skills.name: Hunting Blade
skills.desc: Deals minor Imaginary DMG (250% ATK) to a single target.

skills.name: Vortex Leap
skills.desc: Deals minor Imaginary DMG (150% ATK) to a single target and units adjacent to the target.

enemies.name: Voidranger: Trampler
enemies.lore:
A product of the Antimatter Legion utilizing the Warforge to recast and fuse remnants of fallen warriors and leviathans.
Though relatively rare, they possess both the intelligence of a warrior and the power and mobility of a leviathan. Its screech can summon a large number of Voidrangers.

skills.name: Unreal Projection
skills.desc: Deals Quantum DMG (300% ATK) to a single target.

skills.name: Rule of Force
skills.desc: Deals Quantum DMG (400% ATK) to a single target.

skills.name: War Trample
skills.desc: Deals minor Quantum DMG (250% ATK) to a single target and units adjacent to the target.

skills.name: Spiral Arrow
skills.desc: Locks on to a single target. Cast End of Bow to this target in the next action.

skills.name: End of Bow
skills.desc: Deals massive Quantum DMG (600% ATK) to a single target, with a high chance (100% Base Chance) to inflict Entanglement (50% Action Delay, 80% ATK Delayed DMG Per Stack).

enemies.name: Warp Trotter
enemies.lore: An interdimensional creature lost in the stars. Docile in nature. Sweet in taste. Inedible. Spends most of its life feeding and fleeing. Travelers who encounter these creatures see them as good omens.

skills.name: S—S—S—Scared
skills.desc: The Treasure Trotter got spooked and will flee in 2 turns.

skills.name: Run... Run!
skills.desc: The Treasure Trotter is panicking and will flee in 1 turn.

skills.name: Phew... Escaped
skills.desc: The Trotter flees in an instant.

enemies.name: Windspawn
enemies.lore: Crystallized elements with only the simplest intelligence. It drifts in the Fragmentum in the form of a bird engulfed in twisting winds, raging on like a tornado.

skills.name: Windpath
skills.desc: Deals minor Wind DMG (250% ATK) to a single target, with a high chance (100% Base Chance) to inflict Wind Shear (80% ATK DoT Per Stack, 2 Turns, Max 5 Stacks).

enemies.name: Wonder Forest's Banacademic Office Staff
enemies.lore: Sweet Dreams Troupe with their reason clouded by the shade of the AtaviSearch Forest. They carry with them the memetic virus borne into fruit in the Wonder Forest, banaoldly promoting the banacreed of the Slumbernana Monkey and Dr. Primitive's banadvice.

skills.name: Pride of the Monkey Pack
skills.desc: In this battle, Wonder Forest's Banacademic Office Staff shares HP with all Banacademic Office members.

skills.name: Banacademic Curriculum
skills.desc: Adds "End-of-Semester Dinner" on the Action Order. Every time "End-of-Semester Dinner" takes action, dispels all Crowd Control debuffs and Weakness Broken states on all Banacademic Office members on the field, switches all "Off-Class Channel" states on all Banacademic Office members on the field to "Classroom Channel" states, and uses "To the Doctor: Banacademic Report." Every time a Banacademic Office member's Weakness is Broken, the action of "End-of-Semester Dinner" is slightly delayed (15%).

skills.name: To the Doctor: Banacademic Report
skills.desc: Increases all friendly units' ATK (20%, 1 Turn). Reduces all target units' Energy (20%) and Skill Points (1) and deals Quantum (200% ATK) and Fire DMG (200% ATK) to all target units, with a chance to apply Slow (-20% SPD, 2 Turns) and a high chance to inflict "Burn." (50% ATK Fire DoT Per Stack, 3 Turns, Max 3 Stacks)

enemies.name: Worldpurge Tail
enemies.location: Echo of War: Inner Beast's Battlefield
enemies.lore: Tail of the Inner Beast, bringer of storms, purger of mortal worlds.

skills.name: Worldpurge
skills.desc: Deals minor Wind DMG (240% ATK) to all targets.

skills.name: Realm Exterminator
skills.desc: Use while in the Resonate State. Deals Wind DMG (360% ATK) to all targets, with a high chance to inflict .

skills.name: Safeguard
skills.desc: Enters the Safeguard state. While not Weakness Broken, reduces DMG received. Once Weakness is Broken, action will be delayed. After Weakness is Broken, increases DMG received.

enemies.name: Wraith Warden
enemies.lore:
A somber warrior that accompanies the Judges of the Ten-Lords Commission to execute missions.
Adorned with the black and white mask that symbolizes the netherworld envoy, they wield a guillotine blade, their strikes echoing the weighty and unyielding duty of the Ten-Lords Commission.

skills.name: Sawing Evil
skills.desc: Deals minor Physical DMG (250% ATK) to a single target and has a chance (35% Base Chance) to inflict Reverberation (2 Turns) to the target. After targets afflicted with Reverberation receive an attack, they enter Strong Reverberation (70% Action Delay, 1 Turn) and then have Reverberation dispelled. Targets with Strong Reverberation cannot take action.
